name: GoalJarFill
job: Show progress to a sales, donation or booking goal as a soft-UI liquid tablet: amber liquid rises in a pressed clay well while a giant percentage numeral inverts ink at the waterline, with the label and raised amount printed beneath
visitor_action: none; moving the pointer across the tablet sloshes the liquid, a tap makes a ripple, Enter stirs it when focused
mobile: tablet turns portrait (4:5), numeral scales to fit, tap makes a ripple
motion: liquid rises with an eased fill while the spring-wave surface sloshes and idles; percent and amount count up; at 100% a goal-reached pill springs in (reduced-motion: filled tablet, still surface, no count)

checks.render: compile-checked only (vite serves tsx/css/woff2 clean); screenshots skipped — shot.sh disabled by Guy 2026-11-23
checks.craft: not self-scored (shots disabled by Guy 2026-11-23); pending independent review

art_direction: Soft-UI liquid tablet: pressed clay well, amber liquid with a sheen and deep base, giant numeral that flips from dark ink to cream at the waterline. No jar metaphor.
